hero.caption: Joshua Barney (1759-1818), Captain U.S. Navy.  Engraving after a miniature by Isabey, published in James Herring and James Longacre, National Portrait Gallery of Distinguished Americans, 1959, Vol., II.   Barney distinguished himself during the Defense of Washington D.C in the Summer 1814.   NHHC Photograph Collection, NH 56818.
